payload.posture: Read 1 Corinthians 4:18–21 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states paul contrasts speech and power while addressing boasting, apostolic presence, discipline, love, and gentleness. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
